episodes.title: PODCAST THE MANSON FAMILY: More to the Story - Episode 21 "Parallels"
episodes.description:
The warmth that once defined life with Charlie has curdled into something darker and more dangerous — the drugs are heavier, the violence more frequent, the control more suffocating. And yet the Family is still together. To understand why, we have to step outside this story for a moment and look at another group of people who also found a charismatic leader who promised them community, equality and love — and who also could not find the exit when everything went wrong. When does a shared belief become a trap — and why is it so much harder to walk away from love, even when love has become the most dangerous thing around you?

SHOW NOTES:
PATRICIA KRENWINKEL, FROM HER 2004 PAROLE HEARING
“DRINKING THE KOOL-AID: A SURVIVOR REMEMBERS JIM JONES” BY JENNIE ROTHENBERG GRITZ ©NOVEMBER 2011 THE ATLANTIC MAGAZINE
TERI BUFORD O’SHEA, QUOTED IN “DRINKING THE KOOL-AID: A SURVIVOR REMEMBERS JIM JONES” BY JENNIE ROTHENBERG GRITZ ©NOVEMBER 2011 THE ATLANTIC MAGAZINE

Thank you for listening to The Manson Family: More to the Story. In this podcast, we focus on peeling back the layers, one chapter at a time, in order to demystify the Family and destroy the myths that leave us in the stone cold dark. 

This podcast series is drawn from my book “The Manson Family: More to the Story” published by Story Stratosphere and is based on historical records, contemporary reporting, and archival research. Citations for this episode can be found in the show notes. All writing, and most narration by yours truly.

The voices you hear reading direct quotations of former Manson Family members in this series are dramatized interpretations — crafted to reflect the known accents, dialects and speech patterns of the individuals quoted, based on extensive research. They are not recordings of the actual people.

Theme music is “Mast” by Silent Partner with additional scoring from “Echoes of Time” by Kevin MacLeod.

episodes.title: PODCAST THE MANSON FAMILY: More to the Story - Episode 20 "The White Album"
episodes.description:
The White Album arrives — and with it, the moment this entire story has been building toward. Not because the Beatles intended anything by it. Not because the music itself was dangerous. But because a man already searching for proof of his own destiny finally found what he was looking for in the grooves of a record. Millions of people heard that album that winter and found in it nothing more than extraordinary music. Charles Manson heard confirmation of everything he already believed — a racial cataclysm coming, a chosen people who would survive it, and one person at the center of it all who had been waiting his entire life to be told he mattered. The White Album didn't plant a seed of madness. It watered one that had been growing for thirty-four years. Helter Skelter was not born that night. It was simply named. And that made it real in a way nothing else before had.

SHOW NOTES:

ZEBRA: THE TRUE ACCOUNT OF 179 DAYS OF TERROR IN SAN FRANCISCO BY CLARK HOWARD ©1979 RICHARD MAREK PUBLICATIONS
